intentEvidence: Cursor Timestamp is built around two ideas those tools usually miss.
motivation: To provide a precise, timezone-aware, and attributed timestamp suitable for collaborative work and AI-assisted knowledge bases.
problem: Standard date and time plugins often use local time and fixed formats, leading to ambiguous records when multiple people or machines contribute to a note.
summary: Inserts a configurable, timezone-aware date and time stamp at the cursor, allowing custom prefixes, suffixes, and styling.
